units.source_text: 吟时竭力装出大人模样。

en.t: Gin tried her hardest to appear grown up.

units.source_text: 源氏面前陈列着四个沉香木盘子，盘内盛着各种新菜。

en.t: Before Genji were arranged four agarwood trays, each filled with various fresh dishes.

units.source_text: 他略尝些菜，举杯答吟道：

en.t: He tasted a little of the food, raised his cup, and answered Gin:
